findings.rationale: The security group ingress rule permits SSH access from any IP address to the jump host.
An IAM role has a trust policy allowing assumption without sufficient restrictions, enabling privilege escalation.
The open SSH ingress on the jump host provides an entry point that can be chained to assume an IAM role via STS assume role.
An open IAM policy grants permissions that, when combined with a publicly accessible S3 bucket, creates an exposure chain.
